title: A London Accent from the 14th to the 21st Centuries
summary: Linguist Simon Roper reconstructs how a London accent would have sounded from the 14th to the 21st centuries, reading passages in period pronunciation. It draws on the Cambridge History of the English Language.
why: HN recommends it as a captivating, accessible tour of how English pronunciation changed, including the rise and fall of the rhotic r.

quote.text: for frankly enchanting 18 minutes of viewing
